Record multiple takes in each board section

Each section keeps numbered recordings with playback and an unchanged local audio export for editing.

Recording requires a Lavish server with the recording feature.

Storage and handoff

Saved audio belongs to this board's canonical file path and the section id. Keep section ids stable when revising a board in place. A new board file gets a separate recording collection. Recordings remain in the server's local state directory after closing the browser. Downloads provide a separate backup.

Selected audio is exported unchanged to a local file. Exported audio survives deleting its take from the list. HTML export and hosted sharing omit the recordings.
